_comment: sim-retreat-station-heartbeat-scope-v1. Purpose: keep the PARKED-STATION heartbeat SIM-gap liveness bound (RESTOCK_STATION_SIM_GAP_S, restock_host/incorporation_ack.py IncorporationAckState.snapshot) tight everywhere EXCEPT the phases where the collect capture is SILENT BY DESIGN -- the post-place retreat and stow at least -- exactly as PR 369 already did for the per-frame /sensors sensor watchdog. coldwin81 cleared BOTH pre-place branch selections (PR 370), set the carton down on the cart and released it (PR 333/334 place_contact_release), and PR 369's scoped SENSOR watchdog held through the empty retreat -- then the run died on the LAST watchdog still counting the capture-silent retreat window: the parked-station heartbeat. The retreat ran ~98 sim-s (see _retreat_diagnosis), the mission did not heartbeat the still-parked collect station across it, and the 60 s SIM-gap guard fired: host-stack.log '[python3-6] STATION_ESTOP_PUBLISH site=tick reason="parked heartbeat lost: sim gap 60.02 s"' -> latched global /manipulation/stop -> collect StageRetry loop that cannot succeed. This key suspends ONLY the SIM leg of that guard over the capture-silent window (the frozen-sim WALL backstop stays armed), re-armed on the next capture-bearing phase, so the tight 60 s SIM budget can stay in instead of the cw82 whole-run widen. Default off => byte-identical.
_host_block: Merge into the mission HOST config block (restock_manipulation/ros_host_config.json, read by restock_host.launch, the host-stack launcher).
_capture_silent_station_heartbeat_suspen:
Suspend the parked-station SIM-gap liveness bound (RESTOCK_STATION_SIM_GAP_S, restock_host/incorporation_ack.py IncorporationAckState.snapshot) over EVERY capture-silent phase. The station node (incorporation_ack) is a SEPARATE process (host-stack.log prefix [python3-6]) that reads env, NOT ros_host_config.json, so restock_host.launch reads this committed HOST-config key and translates it into the env var RESTOCK_STATION_HEARTBEAT_CAPTURE_SILENT_SUSPEND the node consumes. The node then subscribes /restock_sim/manipulation/status for the controller phase and scopes the window with the SAME authoritative set as the sensor watchdog: capture-silent == not restock_manipulation.capture_phases.sensing_render_required(phase) (the shared leaf, re-exported from isaac_sensors as _SENSING_SUSPEND_PHASES: approach/contact/grasp/lift/preplace/place/retreat/release/stow/couple and the carry swing-outs tuck/pan/retreat_tuck). On entry it logs 'STATION_HEARTBEAT_SUSPENDED phase=

reason=capture_silent ...' and on re-entry to a capture-bearing phase (observe / verify) 'STATION_HEARTBEAT_REARMED phase=

reason=capture_silent_exit ...', so a run log shows the exact window. ONLY the SIM leg is suspended: the SIM anchor (last_heartbeat) is kept fresh so the resume sees no stale accumulated gap, and wall_heartbeat is NEVER touched, so the derived frozen-sim WALL backstop (frozen_sim_wall_backstop(sim_gap, wall_floor) = sim budget x 50, floored at RESTOCK_STATION_WALL_GAP_S) stays armed throughout and a genuinely FROZEN sim inside the window is still caught by name ('parked heartbeat lost: wall gap s (capture-silent frozen-sim backstop)'). A station process death (process_alive False) is also still caught. Default off => byte-identical. Validated in tests/test_sim_retreat_station_heartbeat_scope.py and tests/test_host_timers_pacing.py (CaptureSilentStationHeartbeatSuspend, 1x/16x/30x).
_restore_tight_default: With this key ON, the standing tight RESTOCK_STATION_SIM_GAP_S=60 (sim) can be RESTORED for the next hardening run -- remove the cw82 whole-run widen that loosened it as a stopgap (set RESTOCK_STATION_SIM_GAP_S=60 in the run env, the pre-cw82 value coldwin81 carried). The phase-scoped suspension replaces the whole-run widen and keeps the heartbeat tight in the capture-bearing phases (observe / verify). RESTOCK_STATION_WALL_GAP_S stays at its current wall FLOOR (it only ever widens the derived frozen-sim backstop).
_pairs_with: This is the retreat/stow STATION-heartbeat sibling of PR 369's capture_silent_sensor_watchdog_suspend (the per-frame /sensors SENSOR watchdog) and PR 357's place_descent_sensor_watchdog_suspend (HOST) + collect_place_station_pause (RUNTIME, the loaded-place-descent station PAUSE). For full coverage of the whole post-release tail keep PR 357 and PR 369 ON as well AND add this key for the retreat/stow STATION-heartbeat window. Note the difference from collect_place_station_pause: that fully PAUSES the station (both legs, state 'paused') for the loaded place descent; this key suspends ONLY the SIM leg (keeping the frozen-sim WALL backstop armed) and is phase-scoped to the capture-silent window, re-arming at verify.
_requires: Registered in config_preflight.KEY_CONSUMER (capture_silent_station_heartbeat_suspend -> HOST), so a key filed in the RUNTIME config is refused before the GPU boot. Add it to the run's --require list so the preflight asserts it is present in the HOST config (ros_host_config.json) that restock_host.launch reads.
_retreat_diagnosis: Why coldwin81's empty retreat ran ~98 sim-s (the long silent window the heartbeat false-tripped on): the post-release retreat trajectory's FIRST segment is time-parameterized to ~100.67 sim-s (host-stack.log TRAJ_HOST_PLAN npoints=13 goal_pos_tol=0.120 right after RELEASE_CANCEL_STOPPED_FALLBACK: points start (0.0, ...) then jump to (100.6721, ...)), unwinding wrist_2 ~1.33 rad (0.29->1.63) + shoulder_pan ~0.41 rad at ~0.013 rad/s, which dominates the ~118.66 sim-s whole retreat. This is NOT retry churn: there is exactly ONE MOVE_DEADLINE_RETRY phase=retreat (attempt=1/4, a 0.01 s deadline miss, negligible). The same slow first segment is present across cw76/77/78 (first segment 77-100 sim-s, whole retreat 95-118 sim-s), so the ~98 s retreat is the normal shape of this carry/retreat velocity-scaled wrist unwind, not a cw81 anomaly. RECOMMENDED ONE LEVER (NOT implemented in this PR -- not small / CPU-unsafe, needs GPU validation): un-scale the EMPTY post-release retreat move's velocity (the carton is released, so the retreat need not use the carry-reduced velocity that produced ~0.013 rad/s), e.g. a pacing-aware retreat velocity/deadline scale, which would shorten the window toward the ~15 sim-s the firstmate expected. Scope-1 (this key) makes the long-but-HEALTHY retreat non-fatal regardless of its duration, which is the standing-goal unblock.
_bounded_gpu_proof: Re-run the coldwin81 config (GROUND-TRUTH collect, RESTOCK_TRANSFER_MODE=live_pose with RESTOCK_TRANSFER_CARRY=wrist_guard, PR 333/334 place_contact_release + closed_loop_sensor, PR 357 place_descent_sensor_watchdog_suspend + collect_place_station_pause, PR 368 release-cancel handshake, PR 369 capture_silent_sensor_watchdog_suspend, PR 370 pre-place branch-descent-feasible) through scripts/run_mobile_restock.py under /tmp/aile-gpu.lock (HEAVY_MB=2500 for the always-on whispr), with capture_silent_station_heartbeat_suspend:true in the HOST block and RESTOCK_STATION_SIM_GAP_S=60 restored (no cw82 whole-run widen). Expected PASS: the run reaches the set-down + contact release exactly as coldwin81 did, then in the empty retreat the host log shows '[python3-6] STATION_HEARTBEAT_SUSPENDED phase=retreat reason=capture_silent' at retreat entry (and stays through stow), NO '[python3-6] STATION_ESTOP_PUBLISH ... parked heartbeat lost: sim gap' even though the retreat runs ~98 sim-s > the 60 s budget, 'STATION_HEARTBEAT_REARMED phase=verify reason=capture_silent_exit' fires on re-entry to the capture-bearing verify phase, the collect stage completes (no StageRetry loop), and the mission continues toward the complete whole-run video. A genuinely frozen sim inside the window still hard-stops on the derived frozen-sim WALL backstop (named 'parked heartbeat lost: wall gap <g> s (capture-silent frozen-sim backstop)').
